{{Top}}
A '''gene''' was a molecular unit of heredity of a living organism. Genes could be spliced by the use of a [[genetic splicer]]. The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] were created from the [[DNA/Legends|genetic information]] of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].<ref name="AotC">{{Film|II}}</ref> [[Bioweapon/Legends|Bioweapons]] used during the [[Nozho–Weogar War/Legends|Nozho–Weogar War]] on [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]] had the capability to alter genes.<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>
